name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: HBD sliding overlay panel: four placements (left/right/top/bottom) with wide (L/R) and tall (T/B) size modifiers, token-backed widths/heights. Portal + focus-trap + scroll-lock + return-focus + Escape + backdrop-click via Radix Dialog, with .hbd-drawer* classes re-applied so the de-shadowed drawer.css renders 1:1. Controlled open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen; onOpen/onClose bridge the WC hbd:open/hbd:close events. no-backdrop sidebar mode and no-close non-dismissible mode.
